message.reasoning_content:
We need to compare two statements. Both are from same actor (CNI representative). Manifestation A: at hearing on "Revisão do Marco Legal da Inovação para facilitar sua operacionalização" (review of Innovation Legal Framework). They support the framework, mention advances, need further improvements, support PL da Lei do Bem (they "apoiam fortemente ... o seu PL da Lei do Bem"). So stance: FAVOR towards the PL da Lei do Bem (the bill). Also overall supportive of innovation policy.

Manifestation B: at hearing on "Discussão sobre mudanças na Lei do Bem para facilitar a colaboração..." They express concern/alert against voting the PL da Lei do Bem prematurely, saying the current Lei do Bem is not effective, needs deep reform before expansion. They say "alert ... para que esse PL não entre em votação antes de uma discussão mais aprofundada." So stance: AGAINST immediate voting of the PL (or against the current form). So they oppose the PL as is.

Both refer to same specific proposition: the PL da Lei do Bem (bill of Law of Good). In A they support it; in B they warn against voting it without reform. That's opposite stance on same proposition. So STANCE_REVERSED.

Check if both have determinable stance: yes. Comparable: same proposition. So answer STANCE_REVERSED.
